title: Refactor Admin Pages — replace inline patterns with shared components
content:
Refactor all admin pages to use the shared components created in AD-007-1 and AD-007-2. No behavior change — purely replace inline code with component usage. ## Pages to refactor: ### admin/page.tsx (dashboard) - Replace inline

+

header with AdminPageHeader - Replace 4 inline stat cards with AdminStatCard instances - Replace inline table shell (loading/error/empty states + table wrapper) with AdminDataTable ### admin/enrolments/page.tsx - Replace inline page header with AdminPageHeader - Replace inline loading/error/empty states + table wrapper with AdminDataTable - Replace inline pagination with AdminPagination - Still uses AdminFilterTabs (previously EnrolmentFilters, renamed in AD-007-2) ### admin/courses/page.tsx - Replace inline page header with AdminPageHeader - Replace inline table shell with AdminDataTable - Replace inline delete dialog with ConfirmActionDialog ### admin/courses/new/page.tsx - Replace inline header (back link + title) with AdminPageHeader ### admin/courses/[id]/edit/page.tsx - Replace inline header with AdminPageHeader ### admin/users/page.tsx - Replace inline page header with AdminPageHeader - Replace inline table shell with AdminDataTable - Replace inline pagination with AdminPagination Pure refactoring — no behavior change.

evidence.residual: AD-008 will further modify users/page.tsx to add edit functionality.

acceptance: Enrolments page uses AdminPageHeader, AdminDataTable, AdminPagination
Courses list page uses AdminPageHeader, AdminDataTable, ConfirmActionDialog
Users page uses AdminPageHeader, AdminDataTable, AdminPagination
All pages render identically before and after refactor
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
dependencies: AD-007-1 provides AdminDataTable, AdminStatCard, AdminPageHeader. AD-007-2 provides ConfirmActionDialog, AdminFilterTabs, AdminPagination.
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && manually verify each admin page renders identically in browser.
